name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Unofficial local-first, plugin-friendly Cursor-style workbench for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 2000 --names workbench,shell --success command-shell "pnpm --filter @dhd/workbench dev" "pnpm --filter @dhd/shell dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && pnpm --filter @dhd/workbench build && pnpm --filter @dhd/shell build
scripts.test:contract: pnpm --filter @dhd/shared build && node scripts/check-capabilities.mjs && node scripts/check-ipc-contract.mjs
